registration_state: Prepared for root review; no follow-up paid calls. Dataset frozen; runtime/launch registrations must be completed before dispatch.
question: Can compact self-contained membership and a single bounded boundary refinement improve Sol/native named-ID agreement without a material coverage loss on fresh inputs?
scope: Three bounded development rounds and ONE frozen fresh confirmation comparison. Earlier controlled/streaming evidence stays unchanged.

hypotheses.mechanism: Counterbalanced simple cases reveal whether a stable choice-position association survives unambiguous membership and changing description style.
hypotheses.compact: Short practical positive own-membership descriptions reduce interference without changing category scope.
hypotheses.boundary: A bounded development review identifies systematic neighboring ambiguities that one concise revision can repair.
alternatives: Position/order or wording associations that do not establish a universal provider mechanism

data.disjointness: Development and confirmation exclude all prior v2 and seed1042 normalized text, IDs, image/Flickr IDs, source byte hashes, and decoded pixels using the documented decoder. New partitions are mutually disjoint; repeats are preselected confirmation subsets, not new data.
data.text: Same pinned CLINC test/oos_test only. Development18 per10 domains+20OOS; confirmation90 per10 domains+100OOS. Source labels are sampling/evaluation metadata, never model input or broad-category truth.
data.photos: 140 visually accepted natural color JPEGs:40 development,100 confirmation,25 repeat. Exact supplied bytes unchanged, longest edge768..1024; independently supported native longest edge>=1024, original aspect, no upscaling.99 original-byte hashes verified;41 unknown originals remain null. Individual attribution/license/native proof snapshots retained.
data.confirmation_access: Eligibility/licensing curation and hash auditing can access raw files before freeze; generators, reviewers used for refinement, and selection receive no confirmation examples, assignments or outcomes. Confirmation review occurs only after frozen evaluation.
data.model_evidence: Text and exact image bytes only. Exclude Item IDs, labels, local paths, source titles/authors/filenames and provenance from provider bodies.

models.protocol: Unchanged provider assignment_request/response mapping. Stable string choice values, Other last. Native probabilities and raw choice values retained; do not repair or relabel returned IDs.
models.refusal_policy: Typed accepted assignment refusal maps to Other and stops paging; preserve refusal-call and refused-point counts.
models.structured_generation: One joint Sol-high invocation per modality in rounds2 and3, with only the existing bounded retries; invalid structural replies retain charges and are not hidden.

round1.name: Synthetic position and description-style calibration
round1.orders: Four cyclic Latin orders; each named category appears once in every named option position; Other remains last.
round1.golden_key: calibration/golden-key.json; excluded from every model/rewrite input and review packet.
round1.interpretation: Synthetic exact-key accuracy and display-position/wire-value diagnostics only. Long styles are100..130words and closely matched, but repetition, negation, cross-references, wording and length differ. NOT a pure length ablation; no general natural-data accuracy or causal API-defect claim.
retain: Exact candidate order and string values
Errors by constructed class and display position

round2.name: One compact joint rewrite per modality
round2.generation_evidence: Old seed1042 discovery ONLY:200 text/60 photographs; original discovery IDs inherited in provenance.
constraints: No repeated competitor names or long negative exclusions
round2.word_target_policy: Practical targets, not a hidden regeneration/selection gate. Record actual whitespace-separated description counts and target violations.
round2.development_comparison: Original and compact on the identical fresh200text/40photo development input with both backends, K8, original canonical order. Original ten text groups span two possible pages; eight photo groups fit one page.

round3.name: One bounded boundary refinement per modality
round3.generation_evidence: Old discovery plus only preselected compact DEVELOPMENT review cases and sealed coding-harness review notes, with all missing/failure markers. No confirmation data.
freeze_before_generation: Full selected case packet and separate blind key
All raw public judgments and accepted/failed/not-attempted counts
Exact combined input JSONL/image hashes and inherited evidence IDs
Actual instructions derived from fixed boundary template
Exact compact parent hash and per-condition registration
round3.constraints: Same structure, scope, positive own-membership constraints and35/28word targets as round2. No new taxonomy or per-example exceptions.
round3.development_evaluation: Boundary only on the same development cohort; reuse the original and compact comparisons already measured rather than rerunning them.
round3.interpretation: Adaptive reused development evidence; descriptive scores are not fresh confirmation.

selection.baseline: Original imported catalog development Sol/native comparison.
selection.requires_complete: Both full development arms and their within-condition comparison must be complete and verified; structural generation must be complete. Do not score a live prefix.
selection.primary_quantity: Matching NAMED category IDs divided by ALL n points, not by jointly covered points.
selection.coverage_tolerance: At most2 percentage points loss for EACH backend; integer inequalities avoid rounding. Increased coverage is allowed.
eligible_ranking: Compact before boundary on an exact tie
selection.adopted_design: Highest-ranked eligible challenger; Original if none qualifies. Original also wins any exact tie with its named-match count because eligibility requires strict improvement.
selection.confirmation_challenger: Use the adopted eligible challenger. If none is eligible, still freeze the highest-ranked COMPLETE challenger using the same ranking and test it once versus Original, explicitly labeled NOT_ADOPTED. Do not copy Original and call that an intervention.
selection.missing_comparison: If baseline is incomplete or neither challenger has a complete valid development pair, record selection_unavailable and stop the corresponding confirmation comparison; never manufacture a score or cleanse failures with a new favorable run.
freeze_before_confirmation: Exact selected challenger and Original raw file SHA
Actual confirmation conditions with exact dataset/catalog/order/source/protocol pins
not_selection_criteria: Dollar cost or cache hit rate

designs: Frozen selected challenger, including NOT_ADOPTED challenger when required
confirmation.order: Original canonical IDs, identical across designs/backends; definitions retain the same IDs/names/count.
confirmation.stopping: Run once after selection freeze. Never retune on confirmation, replace unfavorable items, rerun to cleanse a failed/unfavorable result, or choose a different challenger after outcome access.

reference_repeats.preselection: Dataset manifest fixes repeat IDs/order before outcomes; repeat must match exactly those confirmation payloads and bind its own primary reference artifact SHA before dispatch.

confirmation.qualitative_review: review-plan.json; targets50text/30photos from challenger strata, including corresponding Original assignments assessed against their own catalogs. All anonymized; no quota reallocation. Not population accuracy.

primary: Matching NAMED stable IDs / ALL n
Direct stable-ID agreement / ALL n, including both Other
coverage: Exact shared-Other IDs and refusal counts
metrics.partition: ARI and pairwise precision/recall/F1 with each Other point its own singleton; conditional jointly named statistics remain explicitly conditional.
metrics.paired: Condition-matched paired named and direct gains/losses plus Sol/native assignment changes. Original-Sol anchoring may be reported only as secondary sensitivity, never substituted for matched-condition results.
other: Per-category confusion relative to Sol, not ground truth
Actual category counts and description word counts
metrics.interpretation: Agreement is not accuracy. Upstream labels are not the generated taxonomy ground truth. Report ambiguity/counterexamples and qualitative-review limitations.

accounting.basis: Unchanged recorded2026-10-20 per-token schedule, not invoices or an assertion of future prices. Reprice every raw attempt independently with Decimal.
accounting.cache_accounting: Subtract cached and cache-write tokens from ordinary input; cache-write is a separately priced input component. Native input all at its recorded native rate.
accounting.unknown_policy: Preserve failed/retried/refused attempts. Missing usage/pricing or unrecorded in-flight completion never becomes zero; show known subtotal with null total/incomplete flags as appropriate.
accounting.timing: Preserve measured active loop/request seconds, timestamps and stage overlap. Never add overlapping arms as elapsed wall time or infer isolated latency from concurrent runs.
accounting.coding_harness: Development/final coding-harness review compute is outside this API ledger and explicitly disclosed; record known identity and unknown/metering limits.
accounting.not_selection: Cost and cache hit rate do not choose the candidate; cache differences confound a simple description-length dollar claim.

nominal_work.note: Logical item classifications, not HTTP requests or charged attempts. Text can page; retries add charged attempts. Coding-harness qualitative review is separately disclosed.

before_any_dispatch: Commit/freeze actual source and executable; source_version verifies old shared files plus new runner/example bytes.
Copy exact protocol/conditions/dataset/pricing snapshots and all fixed fixtures to RUN.

Freeze one fresh registration per condition with protocol/condition-spec/source/executable/input/image/catalog/order/instruction/parent SHA pins, exact expected count, relative evidence paths, actual argv and CWD.
Dry-run the exact fully materialized command; enforce32MiB request cap, zero dispatch, and no existing output/journal/progress.
No null required pin, duplicate condition dispatch, live output overwrite, altered model/options, or unregistered favorable rerun.
adaptive_append_only: Round3 selection packet/judgments/actual instruction registration before generation
Generated compact/boundary raw catalog hashes before their development calls
Selection/challenger hash and eligibility label before confirmation
Repeat primary-reference hashes before repeat dispatch
runtime_registration.failure_policy: Leave every failed/partial attempt and status in place. Registered retry bound is provider-internal; any new experiment invocation requires a new openly recorded decision and cannot replace the preregistered result.

concurrency.note: The preceding frozen Sol stream may still overlap. Record actual traffic, timestamps and loop times; these are not isolated-performance measurements.

required_fields: All registered variants and exact counts
Complete/failed/interrupted/pending state with null unobserved results
Raw evidence and independent audit/archive links
Reason the next bounded revision was made, including regressions and negative findings
publication.history: Append new evidence without changing preceding seed42/1042 cohorts or hiding failed/partial/superseded designs. Do not claim a live result before terminal independent verification.

stopping_condition: Stop after three rounds, one frozen confirmation comparison and the preselected repeats/reviews. Additional redesign requires a new recorded research decision. A negative or unavailable result is valid.
